newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Holmdel, N.J..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Holmdel, N.J..

text.p: The Board of Education of the Township of Holmdel
SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Board Secretary of the Board of Education at the Administrative Offices of the Board of Education, 4 Crawfords Corner Road, Holmdel, New Jersey on
until 11:00 a.m. for the purchase of the above Bonds of the School District dated December 1, 1996 and due (subject to prior redemption) on December 1 as follows:
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount

The Bonds will be issued in book-entry form only, in the form of one certificate for the aggregate principal amount of the Bonds maturing in each year. The Bonds are redeemable at the option of the Board in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale. The Board will furnish Bonds and the approving legal opinion of McManimon & Scotland, Newark, N.J.

The Bonds will bear interest at the rate or rates per annum in multiples of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1% (ascending rates and only one rate per maturity) specified by the successful bidder payable semiannually on June 1 and December 1 in each year until maturity, commencing on December 1, 1997. The award will be made to the bidder on whose bid the total loan may be made at the lowest net interest cost in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale.

The full Notice of Sale, the Official Statement and bid forms are available by writing to Dominic V. Carrea, Board Secretary, The Board of Education of the Township of Holmdel, 4 Crawfords Corner Road, Holmdel, N.J. 07733-0407, or calling (908) 946-1800.
